[[SungWon Cho]] ([[JN145]])|}} '''Delibird''' (Japanese: '''デリバード''' ''Delibird'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Team Rocket]] that followed around [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}} during the latter part of the [[Johto]] saga. ==History== [[File:Team Rocket Delibird happy.png|thumb|left|220px|Team Rocket happy to see Delibird]] ==={{aniseries|GS}}=== Delibird debuted in ''[[EP231|Dues and Don'ts]]'', under the ownership of a [[Rocket Scout]]. She claimed that she and the Delibird were trying to recruit new members for Team Rocket. When Jessie and James told her that they were Team Rocket members, she said that they weren't in the system. James pulled out his membership card, and the scout informed them that, because they hadn't paid any of their dues, they had been kicked out of Team Rocket. The scout then told them that if they defeated a Trainer, they would be allowed back in. Using Delibird, Team Rocket battled {{Ash}}, and despite the fact that he won, the scout allowed them to rejoin. However, she also informed them that her Delibird would be following them around to collect their dues that they had still not paid. In ''[[EP234|Xatu the Future]]'', right before a flood was about to take place, Team Rocket told Delibird that they would pay it back with all of the items from the town that was about to be flooded. After the flood, all of the items were buried under several feet of dirt, and Team Rocket attempted to dig them out. Delibird flew away, promising to come back. Delibird was seen looking for Team Rocket around the [[Slowpoke Temple]] at the end of ''[[EP244|Enlighten Up!]]''. Hiding from it meant that they had to take their punishment for trying to steal the temple's statue. At the end of ''[[EP270|Can't Beat the Heat!]]'', Delibird took all of the money Team Rocket had earned during the [[Silver Conference]]. This apparently completed their dues as Delibird did not go looking for Team Rocket in [[Hoenn]]. ==={{aniseries|AG}}=== [[File:Team Rocket Delibird meeting.png|thumb|220px|Delibird meeting with Team Rocket]] In ''[[AG177|Grating Spaces!]]'', Delibird gave Jessie and James a {{DL|List of Pokémon temporarily owned by the Team Rocket trio|Charizard}} and an {{DL|List of Pokémon temporarily owned by the Team Rocket trio|Aggron}}. It took them back later on, as the two Pokémon were meant for [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]]. ==={{aniseries|DP}}=== In ''[[DP080|The Thief That Keeps on Thieving!]]'', Delibird delivered a {{TP|Jessie|Yanma}} to {{an|Giovanni}} from Jessie. Giovanni did not need Yanma, however, so he had Delibird return it. In ''[[DP191|Memories are Made of Bliss!]]'', Delibird delivered a message to the trio, informing them of their new mission in [[Unova]]. In this episode, it was sent to them by [[Matori]]. ==={{aniseries|BW}}=== Delibird appeared in the ending [[Let's Join Hands]], where it was shown delivering Team Rocket plans for a new {{p|Basculin}}-based submarine, which were sent by [[Dr. Zager]]. ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== In ''[[JN145|Rocket Revengers!]]'', Delibird was sent by Giovanni to deliver the trio’s Pokémon from {{an|Team Rocket HQ}}. ==Personality and characteristics== Delibird is dedicated to its job, as shown by its relentless pursuit of {{TRT}} during the [[original series]], when it was after the money that they owed to the organization. It doesn't appear to care about the trio's well-being, as demonstrated in ''[[AG177|Grating Spaces!]]'', when it found them hanging by a branch; instead of helping them out, it took back the Pokémon it had wrongly delivered before flying off. In ''[[DP080|The Thief That Keeps on Thieving!]]'', Delibird was rather surprised that the trio had something to give it. ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|Ice|Flying|Team Rocket Delibird {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0|1=Present|2=Blizzard}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0|1=Present|2=Blizzard}}}} {{anmov|Normal|Present|EP231|Dues and Don'ts}} {{anmov|Ice|Blizzard|EP231|Dues and Don'ts}} {{anmov/f|Flying}} ==Trivia== * Delibird is the only Pokémon in {{aniseries|PTS}} to have used the move {{m|Present}}. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Delibird}} {{Team Rocket's Pokémon|ice|flying}} {{Animecharacters|ice|flying}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Team Rocket's Pokémon]] [[Category:Animated series running gags]] [[de:Team Rockets Botogel]] [[es:Delibird (Equipo/Team Rocket)]] [[it:Delibird (Team Rocket)]] [[ja:デリバード (ロケット団)]] [[zh:信使鸟（火箭队）]]
